benefitRows.description: 25% Discount upto Rs 100 on Movie Tickets.
benefitRows.offer: Avail of a discount of 25%, upto ₹100 on a minimum purchase of two movie tickets per transaction through www.inoxmovies.com, the Inox app, or the Inox box office.|You can avail of this offer twice in a month.

benefitRows.exclusion: Discount not applicable on convenience fee.
